notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Gameplay improved

 The resource acquisition rate has been lowered. The current resource acquisition will be more reasonable in the later period, and there will be no shortage of gold coins and materials.
 Modified the rules for obtaining free soldiers at the recruitment station. Now the free recruits will not exceed the upper limit of the troop size.


BUG fix

 Fixed a bug in the game where soldiers’ bullets would pass through enemies without causing damage under certain circumstances.
 Fixed the BUG in the game that the critical hit damage was increased too high. Now the critical hit damage can be correctly increased according to the description of the synergy effect.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Gameplay improved

 The effect of Resource Specialization synergy has been modified. There is now a chance that the next soldier recruitment will be free, instead of recruiting the same soldier immediately.


BUG fix

 Fixed a bug in the game where newly recruited soldiers might stand still at the door.
 Fixed the bug in the game where snipers could not execute enemies correctly.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Gameplay improved

 Now soldiers' bullets are not blocked by other soldiers
 Reduced the damage tank received caused by collision. Now tank will not die suddenly when colliding with big monsters, but will only be damaged by the monster's attack power.
 Improved the accuracy of mouse aiming, now the aiming point will always follow the mouse


BUG fix

 Fixed a bug that caused the start button and wave selector to disappear in the game with a certain probability.
 Fixed the bug in the game that when the mouse is aimed at a monster, it will only aim at the monster's feet.
 Fixed some text table attribute errors

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
BUG fix

 Fixed a bug where the option buttons on the main menu page might not work properly.
 Fixed the bug that some monitors did not have resolution options in the settings interface
 Removed the option to set the interface screen refresh rate. Now the screen refresh rate selection is merged with the resolution selection.
 Fixed the bug where the aiming line sometimes does not work properly in the game
 Removed the option to change the game screen in the game, because changing the resolution or refresh rate in the game will cause many unnecessary problems.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
BUG fix

 Fixed the issue where the mouse disappears when returning to the game after calling out the pause page via ESC in the game.
 Fixed the discount effect of the enhanced card. Now it can correctly discount the price of soldiers instead of giving money to players.
 Fixed a bug that caused the camp button to disappear after the wave ended.
 Removed some parts that are not used in the scene

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Change
- Now when the player enters the game, he will enter the battlefield interface by default, the enhancement store panel will automatically open, and the enhancement card will be refreshed for free.
- Clicking the store button again will now close the store page

BUG fix
- Fixed the bug that when calling the pause page through ESC in the game and clicking the save and exit button, there is no response.
- Fixed a bug where the UI in the game cannot be fully displayed under some extreme resolutions
- Improved the situation where some text was blocked
- Corrected some textual errors
